AUM-named fields are estimated trade-derived position values, position counts include zero-net activity groups, performance-named outputs describe activity and transaction costs, and net_flow means purchases less sales. Cents converted to currency units, fee_bps/10000. Portfolio summary includes only portfolios with valid trades. Distinct datasets and field names.
